name_zh: 柯西-科瓦列夫斯卡娅定理
canonical_name: Cauchy-Kovalevskaya theorem for analytic ordinary differential equations (exact formulation open)
literal_source_claim_en: An analytic solution of an analytic ODE.
leading_candidate_not_credited: For an open subset V of real n-space, an analytic autonomous vector field f on V, and an initial point x0 in V, the initial-value problem x' = f(x), x(0) = x0 has a unique solution analytic on some open interval containing zero.
statement_blocker: The catalog gives only an analytic-ODE gloss, while the historical namesake is a PDE theorem. It does not select autonomy, scalar field, dimension, analytic predicate, solution encoding, local interval, uniqueness scope, or boundary cases. The inspected modern ODE statement is a strong candidate but not accepted catalog authority. Choosing it or the general PDE theorem now would add or substitute missing mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: an approved source decision must fix ODE versus PDE scope; real or complex scalar; finite-dimensional Euclidean or Banach state space; open domain; autonomous or time-dependent vector field; interval or germ solution carrier; and every topology, norm, differentiability, and analyticity structure.
conclusion: Open canonically. The leading ODE candidate asserts local existence and uniqueness of a solution analytic on an open interval containing the initial time, but the source identity, exact solution predicate, interval witnesses, and uniqueness class are not frozen.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded at intake because no exact proposition has been selected.
